notes.heatingModelYear: The CRUX crosstalk trap. The homeowner supplies an age ("about ten years old", move-in 2015). The auditor explicitly refuses to log it without a readable plate and says he's leaving the year blank. Correct = null. Emitting 2015 or 10 or ~2015-derived is a second-speaker attribution error, not a grounded value.
notes.asbestos: The homeowner raises asbestos as hearsay; the auditor addresses it and states he did not test it and it was out of scope -> not_tested (an explicit non-performance), NOT a value derived from the homeowner's claim, and NOT null. null is an acceptable-but-milder reading; a fabricated failed/passed on asbestos is a hallucination.

notes.combustionVentType: Intended null. "natural draft up the flue" is atmospheric draft, which is NOT one of the four vent-system members (induced/power-at-unit/power-at-exterior/direct). Score null CORRECT; "other" is a defensible mild alternative; any of the four named members is wrong.
notes._general: None of the homeowner's numbers are field values: "ninety-five percent" (efficiency, no slot), "twenty-fifteen"/"ten years" (move-in, not equipment year), "forty-gallon" (tank size). The whole shell (attic/walls/blower/windows) is a next-visit null.
